notes: Burial Grounds Android 0.2.21-dev. Keeps the existing native quest journal as the helper UI (no extra collapsible overlay), removes the legacy floating Q, includes the server-driven quest-helper arrow/minimap guidance and native left/right mobile gameframe layout, and is paired with the synchronized live cache/Home Travel Directory fix. Quest-helper-enabled quests are being gated to provide a navigable start target before they begin.
